title: Klippo Prebuilt Complete Prompt Catalog
source: Pre-rendered complete prompts from current subcategory variations and existing eight presets.

presets.cinematic: Realistic cinematic commercial, controlled soft light, natural shadows, one smooth motivated camera move.
presets.minimal: Clean studio, balanced soft light, negative space, restrained product-focused movement.
presets.lifestyle: Believable everyday setting, natural light, realistic product interaction.
presets.dynamic: Strong opening, energetic controlled pacing, one clear action, clean cuts.
presets.luxury: Premium lighting, refined contrast, controlled highlights, elegant framing.
presets.flatlay: Tasteful overhead or angled flat lay, deliberate spacing, soft shadows.
presets.creative_reveal: Reveal through framing, focus, light or camera movement; never transform the product.
presets.white_doodle: Thin white 2D doodles trace only visible product contours/details; never obscure the item or add captions.

prompt_variants.10:
VIDEO PROMPT — 10s | 9:16
PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME} (Dress / Jubah). Preserve visible shape, colour, labels and supplied parts. Invent no features, accessories or claims.
STYLE: Realistic cinematic commercial, controlled soft light, natural shadows, one smooth motivated camera move.
MODEL: No human or animal model; product only.
STORY: 0-2s Open with the complete dress or robe silhouette and drape clearly readable; no. 2-6s Let the selected garment settle naturally after one small step; keep its cut, print and fit unchanged. 6-8s Highlight only a genuinely visible dress or robe silhouette and drape; do not. 8-10s End with the complete product in realistic scale and no visual transformation.
CAMERA: Start close on a visible detail, then pull back to the complete product. LIGHT: Subtle rim light only if it does not alter the visible product colour.
AUDIO: No forced voiceover; follow the user's selected audio options exactly. No added dialogue unless supplied; music below speech; SFX only for visible action.
Maintain product and setting consistency, realistic motion and stable hero finish. No morphing, duplicates, watermark, captions or unselected logos.
